brief:
YouTube personality and educator Ms Rachel said she is matching rapper Macklemore's $1 million donation to organizations supporting Palestinians, according to The Guardian. Ms Rachel described the contribution as a "moral obligation" and called on other wealthy white celebrities to make similar donations.

The matching pledge comes as Macklemore announced his own $1 million commitment to Palestinian aid organizations. Ms Rachel's call for other public figures to donate reflects growing pressure on celebrities to take financial stands on the humanitarian situation in Gaza.

title: YouTube educator Ms Rachel matches Macklemore's $1m Palestine donation
